records.interpretation: Diviner PRP is a thermal-model estimate based on first-year observations. Ice stability depth is a modeled sublimation threshold, not a direct ice detection or resource measurement.
records.use_limit: Lunar environmental context only. No Earth-equivalent measurement is connected; values are not cross-body scored and do not prove accessible or usable water ice.
